installation.heading: How to install
installation.commands:
git clone https://github.com/antoinebou13/another-install-script.git
cd another-install-script
sudo bash setup.sh

installation.heading: Project Structure
installation.commands:
+-- docs
|   +-- vendor
|       +-- ...
|   +-- docs.md
|   +-- generate_docs.md
|   +-- ...
+-- containers
|   +-- $container_name
|   |   |   +-- docker-compose.yml
|   |   |   +-- $container_name.sh
|   |   |   +-- ...
+-- src

installation.heading: How to run coverage and tests
How to run coverage and tests
How to generate the documentation
installation.commands:
git submodule update --init --recursive
git pull --recurse-submodules
git submodule update --remote
cd docs/generator
chmod +x generate_docs.sh
bash generate_docs.sh ../docs.md
